messages:
marco-sales: Heads up — SummitAI POC stalled. CTO says they won't proceed without a written regional SLA (99.9%) for Dedicated + a hard monthly pricing ceiling if traffic >1.5B tokens/mo. Also their security team insists on BYO KMS and an attestation. Need rapid internal alignment.

anya-se: Copy. Do they want reserved GPUs or a contractual SLA only?

marco-sales: They want a reserved seed pool and contract language. CTO expects options by EOD tomorrow or they pause the trial.

nina-cto: I can draft SLA text. Need baseline vs peak tokens/sec and acceptable degraded-latency numbers for fallback.

leo-infra: For sizing we need POC traces — can sales drop the last 48h?

marco-sales: Uploaded traces: https://redwood.internal/poctraces/SUMM-20250601 (avg qps ~260, spikes ~950).

devon-sre: 99.9% regionally is feasible with multi-AZ plus warm-standby. If they want financial remedies we require an ops runbook and automated failover to a lower-cost quantized model. I'll prepare a 1-pager.

sam-pricing: Pricing sketch: committed baseline (reserved GPUs) + capped overage for first 60 days. If ceiling implied >$350k/mo exposure, flag finance. I'll model three tiers and post.

legal-bot: Reminder: BYO KMS enrollment requires customer key policy & HSM attestation level; legal will need a short FAQ for the customer. Template: /legal/templates/kms-faq.md

marco-sales: Action items: @nina-cto SLA draft (12h), @anya-se eval/fallback parity tests (10h), @leo-infra KMS one-pager (EOD), @devon-sre runbook + failover slides (EOD), @sam-pricing model tiers (8h). I will consolidate and ping Finance/Legal once drafts ready.

anya-se: I'll run their prompt set against the quantized fallback and share a short eval report. Need sample prompts from customer.

leo-infra: KMS note: we support BYO in Dedicated but cannot access raw CMK material; rotation policies must be provided. I'll make the one-pager focused and customer-facing.

marco-sales: Thanks team 44d. If finance flags credit exposure, we'll escalate to execs. Will update after the 16:00 sync.
